caption: The drawing depicts an ornate mirror frame with a rectangular shape and an elaborate, decorative outline. The main body of the frame is a wood-toned brown color, and it features extensive gold embellishments throughout its structure. The top of the frame is crowned with a sculpted, gold ornamental crest centered above the mirror, flanked by additional decorative scrollwork extending outwards. Gold floral and foliate designs accentuate the upper border and run vertically down both sides of the frame, continuing along the bottom edge. The lower portion of the frame has a pronounced downward curve with a central gold-painted floral crest and symmetrical scrollwork. The inside section where the mirror would be placed is blank, bordered by the elaborate gold and brown frame. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and the artist's name, "Lorenz Rothkranz," appears in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Mirror
